newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SNAIGE TO ISSUE SHARES, TALKS WITH INVESTOR.
newsitem.headline: SNAIGE TO ISSUE SHARES, TALKS WITH INVESTOR.

text.p: Lithuanian fridge producer Snaige said on Tuesday that it is considering a share capital boost to 60 million litas from 20 million litas in the autumn and was in talks with a foreign investor.
"We want to boost the company's share capital by 40 million litas this autumn by issuing new shares," director general of the company, Antanas Andriulionis, told Reuters.
The share capital of the company is now 20 million litas.
Andriulionis said the company was in talks with a foreign investor who may acquire a majority stake in the share issue but declined to name the investor or give any other details.
The company reported earlier a first quarter loss of 4.2 million litas.
Snaige is listed in the group A of Vilnius bourse.
